name: nucleo-matcher-wasm
description: Fast fuzzy finder, powered by nucleo-matcher compiled to WebAssembly
author: Jan T. Sott

scripts.build: npm run clean && wasm-pack build --no-pack --out-dir dist --release
scripts.clean: node -e "require('fs').rmSync('./dist', { recursive: true, force: true, maxRetries: process.platform === 'win32' ? 10 : 0 })"
scripts.bench: cd benchmark && pnpm install && node index.ts
